description.value:
A cryogenic storm rages across the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 kinetic damage and 4d6 cold damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

The area becomes difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

Cast with a tech slot of 5th level or higher, the kinetic damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
